name: What are the immediate steps to handle water damage before repairs begin?

mainEntity.name: What are the immediate steps to handle water damage before repairs begin?

acceptedAnswer.text: You must first identify and stop the moisture source, whether that stems from a failed plumbing fixture, a roof leak, or exterior intrusion. Once the area is completely dried out, structural repairs can begin. Starting reconstruction over damp materials traps moisture behind new finishes, leading to recurring damage. A contractor assesses the full depth of the impact, cuts away deteriorated drywall, and evaluates underlying framing or subfloors before hanging new boards and refinishing walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stop the moisture source and dry out the affected area completely before beginning structural reconstruction or drywall repairs.
